name: DonorPerfect
description: DonorPerfect is fundraising and donor-management software for nonprofits. Organizations use it to manage constituent and gift records, online forms, payment processing, acknowledgements, communications, reporting, volunteers and integrations.
agentUseSummary: DonorPerfect cannot currently be installed as a Relay agent connector because its public materials describe a customer API-XML product but do not publish the technical contract needed to implement it safely. Relay will not request an API key or guess legacy XML routes, procedures, parameters, response schemas, authorization placement, limits or lifecycle behavior.

No publicly verifiable DonorPerfect API-XML operation contract is available to pin as bounded Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: DonorPerfect publicly confirms a paid Custom API Access feature and an API-XML interface that can read and write donor and gift data, but its current public pages do not publish the customer API kit's exact origin, routes, operations, request and response schemas, authentication placement, authorization semantics, pagination, rate limits, errors or credential lifecycle. The public API host currently exposes only a broken login-redirect shell rather than technical documentation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider when an authorized Pro customer or DonorPerfect provides Relay the current official API-XML kit and applicable integration terms for review; then implement the complete documented surface with fixed origins, encrypted customer credentials, bounded donor-data handling, Safe approvals, audits and representative staging acceptance.

evidence.supports: DonorPerfect describes a real-time API-XML interface for server-side web programmers that can create or update records and says instructions, sample pages and templates are provided, but the public page does not expose the callable technical contract.

DonorPerfect states that its API toolkit can retrieve and write essential donor and gift tables for websites, third-party applications and custom databases, confirming that sensitive constituent and contribution data is in scope.
DonorPerfect's current US pricing guide lists Custom API Access only with the Pro suite, so an eligible paid customer context is required before technical acceptance.

DonorPerfect release notes confirm continued XML-API maintenance and self-service API-key management, but do not publish endpoints, schemas, permission boundaries, limits or a distributable integration contract.
The public API host currently renders only a login-redirect shell whose referenced appsettings.json returns 404; it does not expose a public technical reference that Relay can safely implement.
